actual: Follow-up publication half of BUG-1986. Monthly ACTIVATE CAS currently ignores the independently active database PIT rule and can publish canonical files while new online consumers use legacy. Bind existing activation intent and readback to shared canonical policy and coverage using read-only resolver, preserving READY assets, retries, rollback and production authorization. Separate source PR because runtime target is worker-scheduler, while BUG-1986 targets backend-main.
